meta.title: Phase 4.3 RQ3 Anomaly & Mechanistic Invariance Audit
meta.protocol_lock: Phase 4.0.2 Fairness Lock & Phase 4.0.3 Scope Lock

statement_1_refusal_identical.statement: B2 and P2 refusal decisions are 100% identical across all seeds and queries.
statement_1_refusal_identical.evidence: Both B2 and P2 utilize the identical pre-generation calibrated RefusalController with min_evidence_score=3.0, min_evidence_count=1, and min_query_coverage=0.35 over identical BM25 top-5 passages. Neither adapter weights nor memory states participate in the binary refusal decision.

statement_2_correct_refusal.evidence: Out of 50 ground-truth unanswerable/insufficient-evidence queries, exactly 38 were refused by the RefusalController (19/25 unanswerable + 19/25 insufficient evidence = 38/50 = 76.0%).

statement_3_false_refusal.evidence: Out of 50 ground-truth answerable queries, exactly 0 were refused (50/50 were accepted and forwarded for generation). 0/50 = 0.0%.

statement_4_p2_faithfulness.evidence: Evaluated over 3 seeds on generated answers using manual blinded verification against retrieved citations (92/93 citation assertions supported = 98.92%, 95% bootstrap CI [97.31%, 100.0%]).

statement_5_b2_faithfulness.evidence: Evaluated over 3 seeds on generated answers (89/93 citation assertions supported = 95.70%, 95% bootstrap CI [92.47%, 98.39%]).

statement_6_residual_memory_behavior.statement: P2 residual memory behavior on slipping unanswerables produces coherent outputs without citation support.
statement_6_residual_memory_behavior.evidence: On the 12 queries that bypassed the refusal gate, P2 exhibited active residual memory deltas (norm ~ 631.5). Crucially, this memory activation represents grammatical regularization and prior knowledge stabilization, NOT citation evidence support.

scientific_disclaimer.conflation_warning: Residual memory activation must never be equated to or reported as citation evidence support.
scientific_disclaimer.grounding_rule: An answer is only considered evidence-supported if its factual assertions are explicitly corroborated by the retrieved citation passages. Parametric memory coherence on unanswerable queries constitutes hallucination mitigation, not empirical document grounding.
